opponent.label: The Flash
opponent.description: "My name is Lia Nelson and I am a living flash of light. My parents were astronauts on a mission to study the impossible. Then, somehow, being conceived and born on a space station made me the impossible. To the outside world I'm just an ordinary celebrity and ultra-popular superhero. But secretly, I work with my friends in the Secret Six to expose the shadow government Nightwing and get justice for the victims of the Red Tornado bio-weapon. I am... The Flash!"
